_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: Replaces the floating 'PAD n  0/4' label. Stands on the floor just behind the pad: origin at pad centre + (0, 0, +5.9) in Roblox (5.9 studs behind the pad centre, away from the spawn), facing the spawn like the pad. Put the SurfaceGui on an invisible 8 x 3 part at textFace.center (front face 0.16 in front of the sign's middle).
